# 1stStep.ai

> 1stStep.ai is a supervised AI job-search product. It checks whether roles are still open, prepares role-specific resumes and cover letters from facts the user confirms, and keeps the applicant in control of anything sent to an employer.

## Canonical pages

- [1stStep.ai home](https://app.1ststep.ai/): Product overview, controls, and current beta information.
- [Job Agent](https://app.1ststep.ai/concierge): Start and manage the supervised job-search workflow.
- [Pricing](https://app.1ststep.ai/pricing): Current access and pricing information.
- [Where to find app.1ststep.ai](https://app.1ststep.ai/where-to-find-1ststep-ai/): Public profiles and external listings verified by 1stStep.ai.
- [Privacy](https://app.1ststep.ai/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms](https://app.1ststep.ai/terms): Terms of service.

## Product boundaries

- 1stStep.ai prepares tailored application materials from facts the user confirms.
- The Chrome extension supports supervised review and user-approved ordinary-field filling on supported Greenhouse pages.
- The applicant handles employer sign-in, passwords, passkeys, one-time codes, CAPTCHAs, signatures, attestations, sensitive questions, and final submission.
- An application is not described as submitted until employer receipt is confirmed.
